The doctor did not speak English and made no effort to communicate. He did not review my kitten’s chart and prepared duplicate vaccines that had already been given at the previous appointment.

Best veterinarian care facility that I have ever encountered, upscale, and extremely clean. Doctor Natacha Lau and Dr. Fernandez are amazing professionals with incredibly pleasant and personal attention to their patient and us. The cost was extremely inexpensive for the service provided.

Everyone who works there go above and beyond to help you with information, consolement , clarity and patience.
All employees are very knowledgeable, from the amazing manager, the receptionists, the assistants , and
Dr Herrera was so kind and ephathetic, and  humblealong with his expertise.
People and their pets is a highly emotional and touchy subject and everyone handled it top notch
I was not the easiest customer myself, and their patience with me  was limitless
I shopped around for affordable vet care in Miami, and was an impossible mission , until I was blessed with hearing about them. Top notch professionalism, with by far the fairest prices around , and must mention how clean and spotless it is.
The overall vibe is hospitable , caring , & gentle, & compassionate. As mentioned, People and their pets is such a delicate matter and the composure is high.
Considering the care my cat recieved, the patience and caring that i recieved , the detail oriented and organized system , the assesabitity, the incredibly affordable prices , this stands out as the best of the best. Grateful to staff and Dr Herrera for putting up with me , ( they have a natural calming effect which was much needed in my case. Very grateful

The worst customer service ever. I had an appointment scheduled for a certain time, called in advance to let them know I was running late and ask for a later time if possible. The girl on the phone was really rude and kept repeating I had to be on time for my appointment. Their services are really expensive, therefore, they should improve their customer service.

Best Animal care, they really care!!
love Doc Campos!!!
Excellent, very humane, cost conscious. Wish they would have emergency too… highly recommend

My experience was excellent. Dr. Roberto Fernandez demonstrated not only great clinical knowledge but also a high level of professionalism and dedication when I brought my dog ​​Bianca in for an emergency this Saturday. Dr. Fernandez not only explained my pet's condition in detail but also showed honesty and empathy—qualities that many veterinarians lack.
Thanks Dr Fernandez.
The Local is spotless! The staff are incredibly friendly and caring with all the animals, and the prices are competitive.

I’ve been going to Pet Lovers for over 24 years. Always treated with respect and consideration. Today I brought my 12 year old female Pom to look at a problem with a bad tooth.  Right off I was asked to pay 1,000,00 plus anything else after.  I tried to explain that I’m a senior and can’t afford it if they can give me some type of advice and a young man about 25 years old said all listed was necessary and they could not work work with me.  I said after 24?years you are telling me you aren’t going to be pleasant, should I go to the Humane society then?  He shrug his shoulders.  I walked out crying.  The management is changed and obviously not love animals.
I do not understand why they do not respect the appointment times. Almost 2 hours waiting with a appt. The scheduling of appointments is the worst I have ever seen

My experience today was extremely stressful. The doctor was excellent, but the customer service was terrible, especially the girls. It was like you had to ask for money to be seen, and they should provide professional training for the girls at the front.

It's incredibly expensive. It's a cash cow. You barely walk in before you leave with a bill for over $1,000. And you don't even have proof that they did those tests. They charged me for heart and kidney x-rays of my cat that they never even showed me. Just to tell me about the tests, they wanted to charge me $300. This is outrageous, this is a cash cow... I don't recommend them because in the end you end up paying more than if you went to any other vet. I went there because a friend recommended them as cheap, but honestly, they're super expensive and not trustworthy.

Terrible wait time even with an appointment. Everyone that works at the front desk has an attitude no college degree but so much attitude. The doctors barely speak English. They have a translator that barely speaks English. My Dog had to wait three hours. Just for them to be constantly taking him in and out of the back. If you have an elderly dog, this is so stressful terrible terrible terrible service.

Yesterday I took my dog ​​to the clinic, and everyone there treated us very well—quickly, efficiently, and very responsible with the animals. They performed emergency surgery on her. Dr. Herrera was the best. I'm so grateful to God for leading me to this clinic, which has excellent care and reasonable prices, unlike some other places. So I'll continue taking my dog ​​there.

The staff is terrible very rude end inconsiderate they told me it would take 45 minutes so I went to wait in the car I finally got off after an hour and went to ask for the cat they said it was 45 minutes more they knew I went to wait in my car no one notified me. They are very unprofessional and treat us if they're doing you a favor instead of providing you a service that you're paying for and they are quite expensive.

My dog ​​was treated at Pet Lovers for 12 years, and I couldn't have chosen a better clinic. From the doctors to all the other employees, they always treat you very professionally. I highly recommend it to everyone; excellent service.
Excellent service and reasonable prices!

*$1000.00* I took my dog ​​for a second consultation for a patella problem. Just for taking some x-rays and giving him some medication, they wanted to charge me $1000. The consultation itself was $20, but don't be fooled, it's just a way to get money out of you. They're real crooks! You'd have to be willing to throw money away or be crazy to go there!

Recommend it 100%
Good prices for services
Perfect service , they are the best clinic
Good Doctors and people in the front desk, every body it’s nice
Never had a bad experience at this vet..Ana and dr.cabo are great..

Absolutely unacceptable.

This clinic has repeatedly demonstrated an alarming lack of professionalism, responsibility, and basic competence. I trusted them to care for my dog ​​for a long time, and that was clearly a mistake.

When I took my dog ​​in for his rabies vaccination, they didn't even have the county tag available, and worse, they didn't explain what additional paperwork I needed to complete afterward. Because of their negligence and failure to provide essential information, I ended up receiving a $165 fine from the county. As a first-time pet owner, I relied on this veterinarian for proper guidance. They failed to do their job.

And the worst part is, this wasn't an isolated incident. On another visit, after drawing blood from my dog, they left bruising and swelling on his neck. Seeing my dog ​​return like that was outrageous and completely unacceptable.

I find this veterinary clinic negligent, poorly managed, and unreliable. They don't properly inform owners, they don't provide adequate guidance, and, in my experience, they don't treat animals with the care one would expect from professionals.

I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. If you are looking for competent service, clear information and peace of mind, this is not the place.

Dr. Fernandez is great! He did all the proper tests and didn’t waste any time. Got my dog healthy again quickly and effectively. We’re very appreciative. My biggest complaint is if you’re a walk-in, expect long wait times.

Pets Lovers Veterinary Clinic, especially the staff at the front desk, are kind and compassionate, but Dr. Herrera deserves five stars because there aren't any more. He's incredibly compassionate, takes the time to explain the procedure, the pros and cons, and goes into detail about each step. He's a human being who loves his profession. I've already chosen him as the doctor for my three fur babies. I highly recommend him; don't read the reviews on social media. It's a prestigious clinic; my dog ​​Dior had a C-section there four years ago. If you're looking for a place where your pets will be treated with love and compassion, don't hesitate. Plus, the prices are unbeatable. The Pets Lovers clinic on SW 8th St. is excellent.
